items.name: 2026 US midterms
items.summary: Campaign for the 3 Nov 2026 midterms, with the House (218–214 R) and Senate (53–47 R) at stake, including the administration's lawsuits over ballots and certification in California and Alaska.

items.name: US–Iran war and negotiations
items.summary: The US–Iran conflict, the US blockade of Iranian ports, stalled talks, threat reporting and spillover across the Gulf.

items.name: US tariffs and trade deals
items.summary: US tariff actions (Section 232/338 proclamations, the Canada tariff war) and bilateral trade deals after the Supreme Court struck down the emergency-power tariffs.

items.name: ACA marketplace eligibility tightening
items.summary: CMS rules tightening eligibility verification for ACA marketplace subsidies.

items.name: FDA Closer to Zero
items.summary: FDA programme setting action levels for lead, arsenic, cadmium and mercury in baby food.

items.name: Polish coalition stability and Polska 2050
items.summary: Strains in Donald Tusk's governing coalition, including the split in Polska 2050 and the fight over the funds ministry.

items.name: Poland 2027 tax reform
items.summary: The government's PIT/CIT reform for 2027, Sejm amendments and the Senate's attempt to reverse them.

items.name: Poland abortion law
items.summary: Bills liberalising Poland's abortion rules, their path through the Senate and the expected presidential veto.

items.name: President–government conflict in Poland
items.summary: Clashes between President Karol Nawrocki and the Tusk government: vetoes, appointments, foreign policy and judicial reform including the Constitutional Tribunal dispute.

items.name: Poland digital services tax
items.summary: Plans for a 3% tax on the revenue of large global tech firms in Poland, and the US reaction.

items.name: Polish nuclear power programme
items.summary: The large AP1000 plant in Pomerania and small modular reactor (SMR) projects.

items.name: Local recall referendums in Poland
items.summary: Recall votes against mayors (Kraków in May, Częstochowa in October 2026) and the snap elections that follow.

items.name: Ukraine security guarantees
items.summary: The 'coalition of the willing', European security guarantees for Ukraine and Poland's role.

items.name: Gibała's first months as Kraków mayor
items.summary: Łukasz Gibała's reorganisation of City Hall, budget, fares and tourist fee after his October 2026 election.

items.name: Kraków transit and fares
items.summary: Kraków tram and bus changes, fare reform (20- and 40-minute tickets), rail works around the city and seasonal transit plans.

items.name: Opposition vs Election Commission over SIR
items.summary: The opposition's campaign against the Election Commission over the Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls.

items.name: Gulf conflict and Indians abroad
items.summary: Impact of the Gulf war on Indian nationals, Umrah pilgrims, flights and remittances.

items.name: India oil shock and markets
items.summary: Effect of high crude prices from the Gulf conflict on Indian markets, the rupee and inflation.

items.name: India disinvestment
items.summary: Government plans to list or sell stakes in state-owned firms.

items.name: Karnataka politics and governance
items.summary: Karnataka state government: drought relief row with the Centre, the KPSC exam scam and governance disputes.

items.name: India–US trade deal
items.summary: Negotiations on the first tranche of a US–India trade agreement and tariffs linked to Russian oil.

items.name: Quad and India–US diplomacy
items.summary: Quad meetings, the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta and high-level India–US contacts.

items.name: US visas and Indian workers
items.summary: The $100,000 H-1B fee and its litigation, state H-1B hiring bans and student visas.

items.name: Permanent US base in Poland
items.summary: Poland's push for a permanent US Army base ('Fort Trump'), costs, candidate sites and the US force-posture review.

items.name: US–Poland and Ukraine diplomacy
items.summary: US and Polish positions on the Russia–Ukraine peace process, including the US ambassador's public statements.

items.name: Poland–India strategic partnership
items.summary: Follow-up to Tusk's October 2026 visit to India: trade, defence-industry dialogue and agreements.

items.name: Poland fuel price caps
items.summary: The 'Ceny Paliwa Niżej' package: daily maximum fuel prices, VAT and excise cuts, and a windfall tax on fuel companies, under review by the Constitutional Tribunal.

items.name: Kraków–Lviv partnership and the Year of the UPA
items.summary: How Kraków, Małopolska and other Polish local governments are responding to the Lviv Oblast Council naming 2027 the Year of the UPA and Shukhevych, including Kraków's planned suspension of its partnership with Lviv.

items.name: US economy and markets
items.summary: Fed policy under Chair Warsh, inflation driven by oil prices, and market reaction to the war and the midterms.

items.name: Poland monetary policy and NBP
items.summary: RPP rate decisions, NBP projections, the fight over NBP board seats, and the bid to put Glapiński before the State Tribunal.

items.name: Cyberattacks on Polish infrastructure
items.summary: Attacks on Polish companies and utilities, including industrial control systems, with CERT Polska and Digital Affairs Ministry responses.

items.name: Agnipath and Agniveer retention
items.summary: What happens to the first Agniveer batch, which finishes its four-year term on Nov 21, 2026: extensions, retention rates and the future of the scheme.

items.name: Poland public finances and credit ratings
items.summary: Rising deficits (above 6–7% of GDP) and debt heading toward 70% of GDP have led Moody's to downgrade Poland to A3 (Sept 2026) and S&P to a negative outlook (Nov 2026). The government blames presidential vetoes, and Fitch's next review and bond yields are the things to watch.

items.name: Delhi-NCR air pollution season
items.summary: The winter smog season in Delhi-NCR: GRAP stages, Supreme Court hearings (next Nov 16), stubble burning in Punjab and Haryana, and the Diwali cracker window (Nov 7–8). Expected to run until January.

items.name: Kraków Main Square shooting
items.summary: Mass shooting on Rynek Główny on Nov 7, 2026: a 24-year-old gunman killed six people and wounded about 16; three relatives were found dead at his home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski. Follows the investigation, charges, motive, gun-permit debate and the city's recovery.

items.name: Ladakh statehood protests and council polls
items.summary: Sonam Wangchuk and Leh/Kargil groups oppose winter local and hill council elections (Nov 21, Dec 4) amid the statehood/Sixth Schedule campaign; the administration has restricted Wangchuk for 60 days.

items.name: US measles resurgence
items.summary: Measles spread across the US in 2025-26, with more than 5,400 cases and up to 10 deaths in 2026; PAHO revoked US elimination status in November 2026 amid disputes over how HHS counts deaths.

items.name: Nvidia leadership crisis
items.summary: Jensen Huang's ouster over an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, the board probe, the reinstatement campaign, congressional scrutiny of chip-export controls, and the CEO search.

items.name: Poland Constitutional Tribunal crisis
items.summary: The fight over who controls the Constitutional Tribunal: Korwin-Piotrowska and the Sejm-elected judges against President Święczkowski, backed by the President. It covers the immunity and detention motions, the Palace's Belweder talks on a constitutional 'reset', and rival legal rulings.

items.name: Kraków city finances and the 2027 budget
items.summary: Mayor Gibała's attempt to cut Kraków's deficit and debt: the 390m zł current-spending gap in 2026, the 2027 draft budget (957m zł deficit, 300m zł in claimed savings), tax rates, leaving associations, and council negotiations up to adoption by 31 Dec.

items.name: UP 2027 election build-up
items.summary: Run-up to the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly election: the draft roll under SSR 2027, BJP strategy meetings and Mathura rhetoric, SP–Congress seat-sharing, and state welfare launches (tablets).

items.name: FDA leadership vacuum
items.summary: The FDA has had no confirmed commissioner since Makary left in May 2026. Overton's nomination was withdrawn on Nov 17, Kyle Diamantas is acting commissioner, and a new nominee and HELP Committee dynamics are next.

items.name: Kraków Clean Transport Zone (SCT) overhaul
items.summary: Mayor Gibała's plans to change the Clean Transport Zone: the fee freeze for 2027–28, shrinking the zone from about 196 km² to about 1 km², looser resident exemptions, the promised referendum, clean-air groups' opposition and court challenges, up to the council votes in early 2027.

items.name: Anthropic IPO and AI market valuations
items.summary: The record $81bn Anthropic listing, its trading and lock-ups, plus Fed and market worries over AI debt and valuations.

items.name: Federal permitting overhaul
items.summary: The bipartisan BAAJA permitting reform (NEPA, ESA and Clean Water Act reviews, litigation limits, FERC transmission authority, data-centre ratepayer protections) passed the Senate 62-33 on Nov 19, 2026 and goes to the House.

items.name: Russian missiles and drones over Poland
items.summary: Russian missiles and drones entering Polish airspace during strikes on Ukraine (the Kh-101 in July 2026, the Nov 20 2026 falls near Biłgoraj and in Podkarpacie), Poland's air-defence and civil-warning response, and NATO's reaction including Eastern Sentry.

items.name: Pannun assassination plot cases
items.summary: US cases over the foiled 2023 plot to kill Gurpatwant Singh Pannun: Nikhil Gupta's 235-month sentence (Nov 20, 2026), the charges against ex-Indian official Vikash Yadav, Pannun's civil suit seeking to serve NSA Doval and ex-R&AW chief Goel, and India's responses.

items.name: Kraków metro halt
items.summary: Mayor Gibała's decision to halt metro preparations until state or EU money is guaranteed: 0 zł in the 2027 draft budget, the 25 Nov extraordinary council session, the pending tenders (geological survey under KIO appeal), Wałachowski's spending analysis and the Metro Construction Council's response.

items.name: Thiruparankundram deepam dispute
items.summary: The legal and political fight over lighting the Karthigai lamp at the hilltop stone pillar near the Sikandar dargah on Thiruparankundram hill (Madurai): the Supreme Court's one-time Nov 20, 2026 order, Tamil Nadu's review petition, possible contempt proceedings, main appeals listed for Jan 2027, and the BJP–TVK political row.

items.name: Federal cyber breaches 2026
items.summary: A run of incidents against US federal systems in late 2026, including the NSANet outage, the FBI NCIC hack, USDA, CIA/ODNI and FinCEN breaches, plus the White House response and leadership changes at ONCD and NSA.

items.name: EU 2028–2034 budget talks
items.summary: Negotiations on the EU's 2028–34 multiannual financial framework and Poland's fight against cuts to cohesion and farm funds and to the ETS revenue split, plus Ukraine financing.

items.name: Delimitation and women's reservation amendment
items.summary: The Modi government's push to pass a constitutional amendment expanding the Lok Sabha to up to 850 seats via delimitation and bringing the one-third women's quota into force by 2029; failed in April 2026, revived in a special sitting from Nov 30.
